Section: section_1 — The Turbulence Puzzle: Defining the Chaos

Lecture lines:
Turbulence is chaotic, unpredictable fluid motion.
The Reynolds Number governs this complexity.
It compares inertial to viscous forces.
High Re creates chaotic, swirling eddies.
Finley the trout navigates these flows.

Create text 'Turbulence is complex fluid motion.' with #FFFFFF color.
Display chaotic flow vectors in #FF4500.
Draw a large eddy separating into smaller eddies.
Highlight energy moving from large to small scales.
